name: meridian-relief-network
description: Meridian Relief Network — Gulf Coast disaster-relief volunteer matching (POC)

scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env'); console.log('Created .env from .env.example');} else { console.log('.env already exists'); }"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:reset: docker compose --env-file .env down -v && docker compose --env-file .env up -d db
